tasks.label: Start Bridge Server
tasks.command: $env:DMS_PROVIDER_MACHINE_CONFIG_DIR = Join-Path $PWD 'config'; $env:DMS_PROVIDER_USER_CONFIG_DIR = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'DMS Provider\config'; $listenPids = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); if ($listenPids.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host 'Bridge server already running on port 8765.' } else { Write-Host "Machine config: $env:DMS_PROVIDER_MACHINE_CONFIG_DIR"; Write-Host "User config: $env:DMS_PROVIDER_USER_CONFIG_DIR"; .\.venv312\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn dms_provider_bridge.app.server:app --app-dir src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 }

tasks.label: Stop Bridge Server
tasks.command: $listenPids = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); foreach ($procId in $listenPids) { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tasks.label: Restart Bridge Server
tasks.command: $env:DMS_PROVIDER_MACHINE_CONFIG_DIR = Join-Path $PWD 'config'; $env:DMS_PROVIDER_USER_CONFIG_DIR = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'DMS Provider\config'; $listenPids = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); foreach ($procId in $listenPids) { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Machine config: $env:DMS_PROVIDER_MACHINE_CONFIG_DIR"; Write-Host "User config: $env:DMS_PROVIDER_USER_CONFIG_DIR"; .\.venv312\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn dms_provider_bridge.app.server:app --app-dir src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
